title: 第7章 若是师姐的戏那自是再好看不过第8章 啊这这实在是太好了
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 诗芷晴还沉浸在自己被诬陷的心慌中呢，从头顶上方传来的清淡嗓音唤回了她的思绪，一只白皙修长的手随即伸至她面前。
诗芷晴抬起头，她根本没有看林筱手中的丹药，目光完完全全被林筱这个人占据。
阳光由上而下撒在林筱背上，模糊了她冷漠的表情，在诗芷晴眼中，林筱整个人都沐浴在光中，就像是上天派来救赎她的神明，抚平了她不安的心。
如果不是林筱师姐，她现在恐怕已经被赶出天衍宗了吧。
诗芷晴再也忍不住心头的酸胀，起身扑到林筱怀里，用力抱紧了林筱。
“林师姐！”
林筱被诗芷晴扑的后退一步，快速握紧拳头防止手中丹药滑落。
感受着诗芷晴抱着她的力道，林筱有些不自在，她并不喜欢和人有太过亲昵的接触。
不过，看诗芷晴哭的跟花猫一样，联想到原剧情中这小姑娘可是被活活剥皮抽筋了的，她心里一叹，便没有伸手推开诗芷晴。
甚至看诗芷晴哭的身体一抽一抽，她还不习惯的拍了拍诗芷晴的背以示安抚。
突然，她眼神一顿，因为她在诗芷晴头顶看到了两行字。
【系统评价：天赋总分达到及格线，小姑娘美美哒，有点小天赋，可以啦~】
林筱觉得她是出幻觉了，闭了闭眼再睁开，那行字还在。
这是什么东东？
刚才还没有？
就在林筱懵逼之际，脑海中响起一道异常诡异的声音。
林筱形容了一下，就像是一个机器人再用它冷冰冰的机械声音抑扬顿挫的装活跃说话。
声音都扭曲了，听上去分外别扭。
“恭喜宿主，您一人怼全宗拯救自己师妹的英勇行为成功打动了本系统，现在只要您在心里说一句‘绑定系统’，本系统便会和宿主建立灵魂联系，帮助宿主在修真界大放异彩！”
系统？
林筱眼登时一亮。
系统这番话在她听来就是：叮！
您的外挂已上门，请查收。
林筱看了那么多本小说，里面的系统可以分为两类：一种是冷冰冰没有感情，一种是傻头傻脑没有心眼。
就听刚才系统那一句话，林筱判断，她脑海里这个八成属于后者。
既如此…
林筱眼里快速闪过一抹狡黠，她慢悠悠在脑海里开口。
“不绑。”
“好的，马上与您建立………什么什么，不绑？！”
系统机械音也能听出它的惊讶。
林筱一句不绑把它整懵了，它预想的不应该是林筱忙不迭的答应吗，怎么会不绑呢？
林筱没有理会懵逼的系统，把手中的丹药交到诗芷晴手中，“看到这是什么了吗？有了它们你就可以快速突破金丹，但洛云卿会因为你修为高消停一时，却不会消停一世。”
“九位亲传弟子，洛云卿为何偏偏挑你动手示威，她怎么不去找蒋凤熙，温以宁她们陷害？蒋凤熙不一锤子打的她满地找牙就不错了。”
“这回她害你不成，说不定什么时候她又整幺蛾子，我在还能替你说说话，我要是不在你怎么办？”
content_en:
Shi Zhiqing was still immersed in the panic of being framed. The light voice coming from above her head recalled her thoughts, and a long white hand stretched out in front of her.
Shi Zhiqing raised her head. She didn't look at the pill in Lin Xiao's hand at all. Her eyes were completely occupied by Lin Xiao.
The sunlight fell on Lin Xiao's back from top to bottom, blurring her indifferent expression. In Shi Zhiqing's eyes, Lin Xiao's whole body was bathed in light, like a god sent by heaven to redeem her, soothing her restless heart.
If it weren't for Senior Sister Lin Xiao, she might have been kicked out of Tianyan Sect by now.
Shi Zhiqing could no longer hold back the soreness in her heart. She stood up and threw herself into Lin Xiao's arms, hugging Lin Xiao tightly.
"Senior Sister Lin!"
Lin Xiao was pushed back by Shi Zhiqing and quickly clenched her fists to prevent the pill from slipping.
Feeling Shi Zhiqing's strength holding her, Lin Xiao felt a little uncomfortable. She didn't like to have too close contact with people.
However, seeing Shi Zhiqing crying like a cat, and thinking that in the original plot, the little girl was skinned alive and had cramps, she sighed in her heart and did not reach out to push Shi Zhiqing away.
Even seeing Shi Zhiqing's body twitching as she cried, she was not used to it and patted Shi Zhiqing's back to comfort her.
Suddenly, her eyes froze because she saw two lines of words above Shi Zhiqing's head.
[Bones → 6, Comprehension → 5,
Aspiration → 6, blessing → 7, total: 24】
[System evaluation: The total talent score reaches the passing line. The girl is beautiful and has a little talent. It’s okay~]
Lin Xiao thought she was hallucinating. She closed her eyes and opened them again, but the words were still there.
What is this?
Not just now?
Just when Lin Xiao was confused, an unusually strange voice sounded in his mind.
Lin Xiao described it, like a robot using its cold mechanical voice to pretend to be lively.
The voice was distorted and sounded extremely awkward.
"Congratulations to the host. Your heroic act of fighting against the whole sect and saving your junior sister has successfully impressed this system. Now as long as you say 'bind system' in your heart, this system will establish a soul connection with the host and help the host to shine in the world of cultivation!"
System?
Lin Xiao's eyes suddenly lit up.
The system's words sounded to her like: Ding!
Your plug-in has arrived, please check it.
Lin Xiao has read so many novels, and the systems in them can be divided into two categories: one is cold and emotionless, and the other is stupid and heartless.
Based on what the system said just now, Lin Xiao judged that the one in her mind probably belonged to the latter.
That being the case…
Lin Xiao's eyes flashed with a hint of cunning, and she spoke slowly in her mind.
"No ties."
"Okay, let's establish a relationship with you right away...what, no ties?!"
Its surprise can also be heard in the system's mechanical sound.
Lin Xiao's words of not tying it made it confused. Shouldn't it have expected Lin Xiao's hasty consent? How could it not tie it?
Lin Xiao ignored the confused system and handed the elixir in Shi Zhiqing's hand, "Do you see what this is? With them, you can quickly break through the golden elixir, but Luo Yunqing will stop for a while because of your high cultivation level, but he will not stop for a lifetime."
"Nine direct disciples, why did Luo Yunqing pick you to protest? Why didn't she go to Jiang Fengxi, Wen Yining and the others to frame her? It would be great if Jiang Fengxi didn't hit her with a hammer and leave her teeth all over the floor."
"She can't hurt you this time. Maybe she'll get into trouble again some time. I can still speak for you here. What will you do if I'm not here?"
title_en: Chapter 7 If it were a senior sister's scene, it would be better. Chapter 8 Ah, this is really great.
